def analyze(g, changed_cells):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    objs=[(c,cells) for c,cells in comps(g)]
    def perim(cells):
        s=set(cells); p=0
        for y,x in cells:
            for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (y+dy,x+dx) not in s: p+=1
        return p
    print('counts',dict(cnt))
    for c,cells in objs:
        ys=[y for y,_ in cells]; xs=[x for _,x in cells]
        h,w=max(ys)-min(ys)+1,max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        marks=[]

        # matches
        m=[]
        for col,n in cnt.items():
            if n==len(cells): m.append(f'cnt{col}==size({n})' + (' [SELF]' if col==c else ''))
            if n==perim(cells): m.append(f'cnt{col}==perim({perim(cells)})')
        bbox=(min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs))
        border = bbox[0]==0 or bbox[1]==0 or bbox[2]==H-1 or bbox[3]==W-1
        print(c,'size',len(cells),'bbox',bbox,'perim',perim(cells),'border',border,'|','; '.join(m) if m else 'no count match',marks)
